WITH receipt AS (
  SELECT value AS item FROM json_each(:receipt_data)
),
items AS (
  SELECT json_extract(item, '$.product_sku') AS product_sku,
         json_extract(item, '$.quantity') AS quantity
  FROM receipt
  WHERE json_extract(item, '$.product_sku') IS NOT NULL
),
total AS (
  SELECT json_extract(item, '$.total_euros') AS old_total_euros
  FROM receipt
  WHERE json_extract(item, '$.total_euros') IS NOT NULL
  LIMIT 1
),
priced_items AS (
  SELECT i.product_sku, i.quantity, pv.price_cents
  FROM items i
  LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON i.product_sku = pv.product_sku
),
new_total_cents AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(price_cents) AND COUNT(*) > 0 THEN SUM(quantity * price_cents) ELSE NULL END AS total_cents
  FROM priced_items
),
new_total_euros AS (
  SELECT total_cents / 100.0 AS new_total_euros FROM new_total_cents
),
difference AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN old_total_euros IS NOT NULL AND new_total_euros IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(ABS(old_total_euros - new_total_euros), 2) ELSE NULL END AS difference_euros
  FROM total, new_total_euros
)
SELECT old_total_euros, new_total_euros, difference_euros
FROM total, new_total_euros, difference;
